Author: Yodhrin13
Name: HousingMarketShopper
Punchline: Automatically source and buy housing furnishings at the best cross-world price.
Description: Reads a MakePlace furnishing list, finds the cheapest market listings across all worlds via Universalis, then automates world-hopping and purchasing via Lifestream.
Changelog:
1.0.2
- Fix: buying multiple units of an item no longer re-searches between each purchase
- New: world consolidation setting reduces unnecessary world-hopping when price difference is within a tolerance %
- New: retry missed items button re-runs shopping for anything not fully purchased, no re-fetch needed
- New: listing age warning flags stale Universalis data (>24h) in the shopping plan
- New: live gil spend tracker during a run and final spend vs estimate shown after
- New: world and DC hop count shown in shopping plan header
